verdict.rationale: Browserbase supports event-driven automation via webhooks that POST on subscribed events (docs-19/20/21) and can run agents on a schedule or on demand (docs-14), giving building blocks for reactive automation, but there is no documented native 'if event then action' rule engine or trigger builder—users must wire webhook payloads to their own logic. Missing for 10: a first-party rules/trigger configuration UI or DSL, and evidence of conditional multi-step action chains fired automatically from arbitrary events.
